issues.summary: Reword the intro sentence to say the section describes how to use issues and pull requests (PRs) to contribute a change to PyTorch.
Reword to say this document is the source of truth for the process, especially for how to engage with issues and PRs most effectively.

Rewrite the issues vs. PRs explanation: issues are for feedback, bug reports, feature requests and design discussion, and PRs are for discussing and verifying the implementation once the design is agreed.
Rephrase the labels sentence to explain that labels track the state of every issue and PR, so everyone can see the next step and who is expected to take it.
Remove the maintainer-specific line from the contributor-facing section, because contributors should only need the labels and the process, not maintainer details.
Move the 'current status' section after the description of the desired workflow so readers have the background they need to understand it.
